# Provider-visible Innovator prompt

Act as a skeptical scientific innovator reviewing a prospective reinforcement-learning discriminator, not as a code reviewer. I need an independent, result-blind assessment of whether the surviving opportunity-normalized lease-gated rebinding idea has enough direct-value headroom and physical-time heterogeneity to justify one further matched comparison. The setting is a constructed two-agent host with routine callback opportunities, legal KEEP, REFRESH-SAME, and REBIND actions, a twelve-tick lease, direct reward equal to service minus action cost, and post-action IID callback intervals drawn from 4, 16, and 32 ticks. Please seek the smallest observation that could genuinely change the investment judgment, including the possibility that the correct answer is a bounded null and no new experiment should run.

The retained evidence is deliberately mixed. In the registered B1 package, the learned ONLGR policy beat the matched RAW learner on post-action IID direct normalized return by 0.03481940746307373 on average, with a 95% interval from 0.02458681710870283 to 0.04505199781744463. On the same coordinates, however, ONLGR minus a task-content-blind TIMING-ONLY policy was -0.00017138481140136635, with a 95% interval from -0.005218943755004485 to 0.004876174132201753. An older direct-utility record says ROAD beat RAW but lost to NEVER and barely beat SHAM. In B2, a state-dependent exposure-linked RATE-FLEX learner did not materially beat a learned state-blind exposure-linked RATE-CONST learner: the paired IID direct-return difference was 0.0009782886505126948, its 95% interval was -0.0013577707092971786 to 0.0033143480103225683, and the sign-flip p-value was 0.359375. B2 therefore absorbed to a global rate. Its forced-KEEP panel verifies paired behavior when action is suppressed, but it was not designed as a prospectively powered direct-return headroom comparison, and neither B1 nor B2 estimates direct-return-optimal event probabilities across predeclared physical-time strata.

Please determine whether those existing facts already answer the new question or whether one small executable observation is scientifically necessary. The first proposed gate is direct normalized-return headroom over three competent controls: one learned global state-blind exposure-linked rate, one genuine no-voluntary-action policy, and one matched action-shell control that preserves boundary calls, masking, dummy work, action availability, and accounting while severing the proposed informative link. The second gate is a material difference in the direct-return-optimal voluntary non-KEEP probability across predeclared equal-width eligible-exposure or plan-tenure strata on the physical tick clock, with strata and support rules chosen without reading new outcomes. Only if both gates survive would we compare a learned global exposure link, u(e)=1-exp(-lambda e), with a learned global per-opportunity probability, u=p, under identical initialization, optimizer work, shell, conditional mark split, post-action IID coordinates, and direct-value controls.

Develop the strongest compact design for that staged screen and try to break it. Explain which policy should constitute the candidate headroom or finite-grid oracle, how to prevent the oracle from becoming a privileged learned arm, what matched-shell control is actually informative, and whether exposure or tenure strata can identify the proposed heterogeneity without conditioning on post-treatment state. Propose result-blind stratum cut points or a result-blind support-selection rule grounded in the host's declared ranges of eligible exposure through 32 ticks and capped plan age through 64 ticks. State an adequate support requirement, the unit of inference, a defensible material margin, and a multiplicity rule. Distinguish direct return from service and action cost, and require voluntary activity, event-free survival, and stratum occupancy checks. Consider whether a global p and a global lambda can be initialized with the same marginal event probability without silently advantaging one parameterization, and identify any non-identifiability between callback cadence, exposure, tenure, downtime, lease censorship, and action-shell effects.

Your answer should lead with the scientific judgment, then give the smallest discriminator if one is needed, explicit predictions for headroom, no headroom, homogeneous optimum, exposure dependence, opportunity dependence, and finite-budget artifact, plus decisive early-stop and scope-invalidating conditions. Include counterexamples and alternative explanations that would survive an apparently positive result. Do not assume that a more complicated learner is preferable, do not treat implementation or test success as scientific acceptance, and do not infer a literal hazard, causal lease or REBIND value, RAW representational impossibility, arbitrary callback periods or k, variable population size, UAV performance, safety certification, or general PPO superiority. A positive answer can at most justify the matched second-stage comparison on this finite host, checkpoint set, seed set, and optimization budget.

Use the public repository at https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code.git at exact origin-reachable commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81. Read these scientific references through the GitHub connector: docs/research/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/DIRECTION.md, docs/research/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/ONLGR_B1_RESULT.json, docs/research/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/ONLGR_B2_RESULT.json, docs/research/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/ONLGR_B2_STATE_BLIND_EVENT_RATE_FLEXIBILITY_SCIENCE_CARD.md, experiments/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/b2/analysis.py, experiments/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/b2/config.py, experiments/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/b2/host.py, and experiments/candidates/opportunity_normalized_lease_gated_rebinding/b2/run.py. Treat the code as a description of the scientific object and existing measurements, not as a code-review assignment.
